verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's API lets users submit documents, manage signers, and run notarization workflows with webhook events on completion, which could technically be used to notarize a signed board resolution — but nothing in the evidence describes board-consent/resolution templates, multi-party online approval collection, or governance-specific workflows tailored to equity-fundraising use cases; the product is framed around German notarization/incorporation/translation/apostille services. missing for 10: dedicated board-resolution/consent templates, evidence of online approval-gathering across multiple stakeholders (vs. notary-centric signing), and any fundraising/governance-specific workflow.
